The fratres then proceeded to private business. Fratres Leeper, Imeson and White were nominated as tribunes and after a ballot had been taken, Frs. Leeper and Imeson were declared elected. Saturday, November 16th was then decided upon as the date of the Annual Banquet and the question of the Dinner Committee was discussed. The Princeps stated that in his opinion no dinner committee would be complete without Frater Passant and Frater Hare. Frater Passant declined to serve otherwise than in a consultative capacity and proposed the Senate as the dinner committee. This proposal, despite the opposition of the members of that body, was accepted with alacrity by the assembled fratres. Messrs Alderton, Gunner, Bratby, Cartwright, Mortimore and Walter were nominated for membership.
